content: {"episode_id":"ep-05074","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"Cornerstone denied CPT 93271 (Cardiac Event Monitoring) under CO-97 as bundled into another covered procedure. The clinical indication note documents a patient with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness that are concerning for underlying arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency, supporting diagnosis codes I34.0, R00.2, and R42. As stated in the note, the cardiac event monitoring study is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances for further evaluation. We request reconsideration and separate payment of the outstanding balance of 358.2 for this distinct ordered service."}
